discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 to packet 233 (B025); 30 standard WebSearches with excluded domains blocked; reuses 233 keys. Birthstone: per-month dealer pages (Your WDW Store, dated 21 Jan 2016) release holds for Jan/Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec and add Oct Aurora; Apr/Jul/Nov added held; Feb/May/Aug held. MK45 starter set members from DPB per-pin description. Soccer teams named by DPB. New OE: Oct 2016 Epcot/Lava/Small World, DHS 2016 booster, Rogue One boosters, Pirates/Babies/Mickey Shorts boosters (held), Princess mystery 2016. Disney Streets members from a checklist site (year conflict). Hidden Mickey 2016 moved to 2017. Preview pins still held. Dealer listings used only for per-pin existence; their prices not claimed.
